## Project Summary

Successfully created a premium, modern landing page for MyJournal with:

### ✅ Completed Features:
- Next.js 15 with App Router and TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS with custom color palette
- Shadcn/ui component framework
- Framer Motion animations throughout
- Dark mode support with next-themes
- Full SEO optimization with metadata
- Responsive mobile-first design
- 8 complete landing page sections:
  1. Hero section with floating phone mockup
  2. Features showcase with 6 feature cards
  3. Interactive screenshots carousel
  4. Benefits section with emotional copy
  5. Testimonials with 6 user reviews
  6. FAQ accordion section
  7. Final CTA with newsletter signup
  8. Footer with links and social media
